partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Direct suppression of dominant-negative disease gene
results.hypothesis: Decreasing a gene with a dominant-negative disease mechanism may reduce the antagonistic mutant product.
results.body: drug binds and decreases gene; Gene2Phenotype assertion specifies dominant-negative variant form
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule uses explicit disease-mechanism direction, but graph drug effects are not allele-specific and may also reduce the remaining wild-type product.
results.trapi_notes: The direct target and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; source, variant-form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'dominant_negative_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Dual gain-of-function driver suppression
results.hypothesis: A drug that directly inhibits two distinct gain-of-function disease genes supplies convergent directionally corrective evidence.
results.body: drug binds and decreases two Gene2Phenotype gain-of-function genes for the same disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Two independent direct target arms align with two explicit gain-of-function disease mechanisms.
results.trapi_notes: The repeated target and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; two-gene cardinality, source, variant-form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[association1:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[association2:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association1.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association2.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association1.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND association2.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Affected-anatomy-localized GOF suppression
results.hypothesis: Direct inhibition of a gain-of-function disease gene is more credible when the gene is expressed in an anatomy affected by the disease.
results.body: R160 plus Bgee expression of the GOF gene in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: Explicit corrective direction is localized to tissue independently affected by the disease, although expression does not establish disease-stage activity.
results.trapi_notes: The target, expression, and disease-anatomy paths are TRAPI-expressible; Bgee provenance, shared anatomy, variant-form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: GOF mechanism transfer to immediate disease parent
results.hypothesis: An explicit gain-of-function correction for a specific disease can support its immediate broader MONDO parent.
results.body: drug decreases GOF gene for source disease; candidate is immediate ontology parent
results.mechanism_rationale: The molecular direction remains explicit, but upward ontology transfer can overgeneralize from one subtype to a heterogeneous parent.
results.trapi_notes: The target, disease, and one-step ontology paths are TRAPI-expressible; source, variant-form, and ontology-degree constraints require post-processing.

results.name: Dominant-negative gene activation diagnostic
results.hypothesis: Increasing a dominant-negative disease gene may worsen the antagonistic mutant mechanism and serves as matched negative evidence.
results.body: drug binds and increases gene; Gene2Phenotype assertion specifies dominant-negative variant form
results.mechanism_rationale: Without allele specificity, increased abundance may amplify the dominant-negative product; this is a diagnostic countermechanism rather than a treatment rule.
results.trapi_notes: The direct target and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; source, variant-form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
